newsitem.title: POLAND: French Otor buys Polish paper plant.
newsitem.headline: French Otor buys Polish paper plant.

text.p: The Paris-based Otor firm signed an agreement on Monday to buy a 51-percent stake in state-owned paper maker Silesianpap SA from the Polish treasury for 5.3 million zloyts, the treasury ministry said.
It said in a statement that Otor had pledged to invest a further 15 million zlotys within the next three years to increase its capital of Silesianpap, based in the southern city of Tychy.

The money will be used to modernise the Polish firm's equipment and boost cardboard production, it said. The French company agreed to maintain Silesianpap's jobs at the current level during the next 24 months.
